'''Dooce Everton''' was a [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
A [[Detective/Legends|detective]], Everton was hired by [[Senate Security Officer|Senate security]] to discover who was leading the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] gang on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. He had been working an informant named [[Deringon Lobacc]] for several weeks, convincing him to give Dooce information on Black Sun's leadership.<ref name="TOR" />

Everton encountered a problem when Lobacc refused to meet anywhere but the [[Silent Sun cantina]] deep in Black Sun territory. As Everton was known in that area, he asked a traveling hero to contact Lobacc and get his information. Thanks to the hero's efforts, Dooce was able to pass on his findings to the Senate.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dooce Everton appears in the [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', as part of the Coruscant mission "The Pickup".
